Priya: Heads-up  we've got a weird reconnect loop pattern in WS clients starting 2026-11-12T11:46Z. Many clients reconnect after a successful pong. Anyone else? :confused:

Kai: Saw it. Proxy rate-limiter counts inbound pings as "requests" against per-tenant quota. When quota hit, proxy returns 429 on next control frame and client libs interpret as fatal, causing reconnect.

Alex: That explains the geography skew: higher density customers with aggressive client-side keepalives triggered quota and then a cascade.

Priya: Sanitized snippet:
```
2026-11-12T11:46:05.101Z tenant=acme event=ping_in size=9
2026-11-12T11:46:05.102Z tenant=acme rate_limit=exceeded code=429 frame=ping
2026-11-12T11:46:05.118Z session=xyz client_reconnect=1 reason="rate_limit" 
```

ara: Oof. Two issues: 1) telemetry classifies these as client_timeout (bad), 2) metering treats reconnect as new session so billing spikes.

billing-bot: Billing: flagged ~3.2k duplicate sessions across affected tenants; created ticket BILL-2026-444.

Kai: Short-term mitigation: exempt ping/pong frames from request quota accounting in the edge rate-limiter. That's a fast change.

Alex: Also need console visibility: add `frame_type` and `rate_limit_reason` to reconnect events and a panel that shows `ws_ping_rate` vs `rate_limit_hits` per tenant.

Priya: DevEx: publish guidance to client libs to back off keepalive rates when they see 429 on control frames and to prefer exponential backoff (250ms -> 2s) rather than immediate reconnect.

ara: I'll open a PR to change rate-limiter behavior to ignore control frames for quota and add structured log fields `frame_type=ping` + `rate_limit_reason=control_quota` behind a feature flag. ETA ~25m.

Kai: For billing: propose a short opt-in grace: treat reconnections within 1s with same resume_token as continuation (no new session charge). Gate per-account.

Priya: Action items: 1) @ara PR to ignore control frames in quota + add logs, 2) @Alex dashboard panel + alert, 3) billing team prototype 1s resume grace opt-in, 4) DevEx publish client guidance and sample backoff.

devex-bot: note: add client libs advisory to release notes.

Priya: Thanks. If anyone sees the spike again ping me and I'll pause aggressive canaries for impacted routes.
